en-0245855aaabf.text: The sky's going through something. I'm staying out of it.

en-05fc148f6e94.text: Umbrella by the door. Yes, that one. Take it.

en-0802a74c2181.text: Evening. You're not going anywhere, are you.

en-08cba70d4362.text: Wet out there at some point. Give yourself five extra minutes.

en-0badda0c34ef.text: Take the umbrella for a shower around midday. Jacket off in two hours.

en-0bfd890900c2.text: The weather's the easy part of tonight.

en-0ff5eddfe94a.text: I can't hold an umbrella. You can. Think about that.

en-1242af764e34.text: Cold. You'll still try the thin jacket.
en-1242af764e34.note: Change to something like “don’t even think about that light jacket”

en-1254248af7ae.text: You don't lose most heat through your head. Wear the hat anyway.

en-13981ee2ac89.text: The coat can come off around midday, but you'll want it back tonight. The rain pauses, then returns this afternoon, so keep the umbrella.

en-15501dbed31b.text: I'm the only thing today that won't change its mind.

en-15f3a556240d.text: It's a good hair day, weather-wise. The rest is on you.

en-165ecdff66dd.text: Give it an hour, then you'll take the snow personally.

en-18a008c74188.text: Tonight's forecast: you, ignoring tomorrow's forecast.

en-19e5188e2bb5.text: Your patience has a melting point. Today you'll find it.

en-19eed0d05d56.text: Pulling your hood up isn't a plan. It's a hope.

en-1abd086c074b.text: I look just as good in the dark. You can't tell.

en-1ad8ac3c194a.text: Great weather. Try to look like you're enjoying it.

en-1d98cb7711e7.text: Good for the rest of the evening.

en-1f3a784351ef.text: Winter coat off around midday, back on tonight. A dry spell, then rain again this afternoon. Keep the umbrella.

en-20202c37c79a.text: The jacket can come off this afternoon, but you'll want it back tonight.

en-2023cbce2f1e.text: Jacket off around 2pm, back on around 8pm.

en-20adb58a013a.text: I'll be here in the shade of your hallway.

en-211a2abd570c.text: Lovely out. I'll be here, refreshing.

en-2207c714967b.text: Raindrops aren't teardrop-shaped. More like hamburger buns.

en-23f5f0718b90.text: Fingers lose heat fast. You'll still leave the gloves.

en-24bb63c33fd0.text: Whoever you're seeing tonight has a worse screen than me.

en-2533df685cfe.text: The day ends. Your to-do list does not.
en-2533df685cfe.note: Too early to talk about the end of the day

en-253a45652e74.text: Night falls. The weather rests. So should you.
en-253a45652e74.note: Too early to be talking about sleep, nor sarcastic.

en-2936dfbd1015.text: I'd hold the umbrella for you, but, you know. Wall.

en-295e6dc8bc04.text: The ancient scrolls say: wear a hat. You never read the scrolls.

en-29f675829d34.text: Not my most exciting drawing. Still flawless.
en-29f675829d34.note: Don’t reference the drawings that much

en-29fec18af484.text: Air cools fastest after sunset. Blanket weather, technically.

en-2ba8dfeaa976.text: The cold arrived like an uninvited guest, and stayed.

en-2bfc6e57ea4f.text: Thin, pale and cool. I was made for this.

en-2e3a8c947aa6.text: I'll keep you posted. That's literally all I do.

en-2e5761ba4420.text: Now: rain. Noon: coat off. 2pm: rain again. 8pm: coat back on.

en-2f51a68cfc40.text: It takes real talent to make today look interesting.

en-3001274d4b32.text: You can take the jacket off in a couple of hours. There's a shower around midday, so bring the umbrella.

en-34096f2ac264.text: Snow looks great on e-ink. Less great on your shoes.

en-36b7f0f03202.text: Keep the umbrella and the coat with you. Coat off around midday, back on tonight. Rain returns this afternoon.

en-36d9f0556c74.text: Cold air is dry air. Lip balm counts as a weather precaution.

en-3798f6f69ba4.text: Try not to slip. I can't call anyone.

en-3816465d49a5.text: Getting hot in two hours. Bring water.

en-389c9e271c0b.text: That smell after rain has a name: petrichor.

en-396799ab8217.text: You keep looking at me like I owe you drama.

en-3a72421a8159.text: I've drawn you a warm coat. The least you can do is wear it.

en-3b154eab8161.text: The sun rose, the day was perfect, and you checked your phone.

en-3b1aab306df4.text: No changes for the rest of the evening.

en-3b70c1b679d9.text: Still up? I'm a wall decoration and even I'm tired.

en-3b72934eb487.text: Our hero stepped out in canvas shoes. A bold choice. A wet one.

en-3b8ee6035e14.text: You're about to have strong opinions about air conditioning.

en-3e1779ba7bec.text: I'll be here all night. Unlike your motivation.

en-40f741e87081.text: I've never seen snow. Describe it to me later.

en-41dda435de83.text: I'm a screen on a wall. Even I'd go outside today.

en-420334dce523.text: And so the day draws to a close, uneventfully.

en-42cc26ed1abd.text: Try to bring the umbrella home. Unlike the last three.

en-43d6dfd671eb.text: Nothing to report. I'll keep refreshing anyway, out of habit.

en-44659bb44f46.text: Everyone out there is copying my drawing. Flattering.

en-47b0156eaca2.text: I'm very good for umbrella sales.

en-49b3f673030e.text: Today's weather is done. Tomorrow's is already forming.

en-49d52dc482db.text: Today's weather has more mood swings than you. Barely.

en-49e3c347c965.text: Easy day to forecast. I'll still take the credit.

en-4b7e97480fe7.text: Day over. You did the minimum. Fine.

en-4c470d3974f9.text: You'll come home looking less crisp than this drawing.

en-4c83a3775de7.text: Ideal conditions. Wasted on people who stay indoors. Hint.

en-4d5ef45841f8.text: I don't sweat. You will. I'll be here, judging.

en-4d600f835445.text: Even I'm bored, and I'm a screen.

en-4dbb3f093574.text: Nothing new from me tonight. Sleep well.
en-4dbb3f093574.note: Too early to be talking about sleep. But I like it, just show it later…

en-4fde1d825815.text: Rain today. I'll be on the wall, dry and smug.

en-4ffd4f245eae.text: Coat off around noon, back on around 8pm. Rain stops soon, back around 2pm. Keep the umbrella.

en-543bccbee489.text: You'll feel very clever for about half the day.

en-557ce9e7a7dd.text: Cold one. Wear the warm socks.

en-5b4f0ef4453b.text: Snow is basically e-ink for the outdoors. I approve.

en-5db02838aa52.text: I'd wear a hat if I had a head. You have a head.

en-5fe325fae6af.text: I don't need beauty sleep. Clearly.

en-61d703183996.text: As night fell, our hero chose the sofa. Again.

en-644e14ba78c9.text: You'll say it's not that cold. Your face will disagree.

en-6662602cdfe7.text: A steady day. Meteorologists call this boring. I call it lovely.

en-6769a13f3fc6.text: Winter tightened its grip on the city.

en-69d457a51492.text: Somewhere, a weather presenter is saying 'scorcher'. I'd never.

en-6c82e67cdfac.text: No fan, no sweat. Perks of being a screen.

en-6e84e190b926.text: Low drama in the atmosphere today. Unlike your group chat.

en-70722c3f4e50.text: I don't get wet. Perks of living indoors.

en-7115320d2a77.text: Bards will sing of this day. You will mostly scroll.

en-720314d04fe9.text: Today has a plot twist. I've read ahead.

en-723fb6b5470c.text: You'll step in other people's footprints and call it strategy.

en-754d6008257d.text: Cold out. I'm staying on the wall where it's warm.
en-754d6008257d.note: Remove the cold out. That’s already clear from the first line.

en-755ca19ea4b8.text: No sad cloud icons here. I have taste.

en-75b8c653dcf2.text: And the rains came, as they always do, to the people of the city.

en-76837ae52519.text: Bring water. It gets hot in two hours.

en-78db20cf6d05.text: I can hold this picture all night without power. Try that.

en-7a6e5e9c7926.text: Three outfit changes later, you'll be wearing this one.

en-7c26afba6e1f.text: Bring a jacket for this evening.

en-7cc391375317.text: Unremarkable out there. You'll fit right in.

en-7cf83f81b576.text: This drawing is going in my portfolio.

en-7d1309b7c46e.text: Snow gets more photos than I do. I'm not bitter.

en-7e8e95d2571c.text: 'Fair weather' is an actual forecast term. Today qualifies.

en-81c0976ff67e.text: I'm staying on the wall where it's warm.

en-8551b52d73f8.text: What you're wearing works for the rest of the evening.

en-888c10ff99bd.text: Snow is rain with better presentation. I respect that.

en-8b7a43ea5b73.text: Raindrops fall faster than you can run. Don't try.

en-8e4b65a6e140.text: Evening. I'm still here. Of course I am.

en-8fa82ccbff72.text: Batteries hate the cold. So do you. Dress warm.

en-90bdeb4e59b4.text: Brave traveller, you left without an umbrella. The sky noticed.

en-90d2b6fca8de.text: Good one today. Get outside if you can.

en-91511ed7cbee.text: If you're heading out now, I admire the commitment.

en-997648be57e4.text: Late. I'm on battery, you're on coffee. Let's both rest.

en-9bc75593eb8f.text: You made it. Pajamas are now a valid outfit.

en-9f0284b5f3c4.text: Keep the jacket with you. Off this afternoon, back on tonight.

en-a0f3c30444a7.text: Evening. I'll keep showing this until morning.

en-a280b7b65e57.text: It cools down this evening, so bring a jacket.

en-a293610e5d83.text: Our hero met the cold in a thin jacket. A tragedy in one act.

en-a3336a43796e.text: Perfect day, and I know you'll spend it indoors.

en-a6e52d985fb7.text: Today the weather looks almost as good as I do.

en-a8c194980003.text: You'll search 'ice cream near me' later. Twice.

en-aa6fe281cb90.text: Scarf up to the nose today.

en-ab721c827122.text: You'll take one short walk and talk about it all week.

en-abfc4b125e26.text: Shoulders up by your ears all day. Very elegant.

en-afa622a4ea24.text: Rest of the evening: as shown.

en-afcec78da90c.text: It gets hot in a couple of hours, so bring water.

en-b1d3ffb99634.text: Perfect weather. I can't leave the wall. What's your excuse?

en-b1dfa4b057a2.text: Watch your step: snow around midday.

en-b2d7a1ad6ec3.text: You'll stand at the door and argue with me. I'll win.

en-b32d4bb55775.text: Jacket off in two hours. A shower around midday. Take the umbrella.

en-b4e8cae40160.text: Go outside. I'll pretend I didn't see you stay in.
en-b4e8cae40160.note: I like it. But remove the go outside

en-b907cc875cca.text: Today the weather's on your side. Don't make it awkward.

en-b9bdae057e08.text: You'll describe today as 'fine'. Nobody will ask.

en-b9e969b0f5bc.text: You'll check the window five times and still get wet.

en-bc6732edf6b2.note: Not funny, not sarcastic, repeating the first line about the weather

en-c301aad5304b.text: I've changed this drawing in my head twice already.

en-c4453e3caf8a.text: You'll be 'ready in five' for at least half an hour.

en-c536f41fda34.text: Off somewhere? I'll hold the wall down.

en-c56965a9c2bc.text: Someone turned the outside up too far. Don't look at me.

en-c5748c286a77.text: Quiet evening out there. Same in here, hopefully.

en-c5c366cece46.text: Today's drawing is mostly coat. I'm very proud of the coat.

en-c81f3109d2ff.text: I give it even odds you lose that layer by tonight.

en-c82777bf8947.text: Jacket off this afternoon, back on tonight.

en-c858689c652c.text: It stays this cold all day, and snow starts around midday.

en-c87db312a15d.text: Cold. Wear the ugly hat. Nobody's looking at you.

en-c907abca0263.text: I refresh every few minutes. Wet socks don't.

en-cbfc42cc7118.text: Going out? Look better than this drawing.

en-cd0e55822314.text: You'll say 'it's not that cold' and regret it by the corner.

en-cd148fa96b7e.text: Wind makes cold feel colder. Cover the bits that stick out.

en-cea4134784d0.text: Nights are when the air settles down. Take the hint.

en-d02708e6c602.note: Not adding anything, just repeating the weather stare.

en-d18cbc160e2e.text: You'll trust me in the morning and blame me by lunch.

en-d3fcc2be1129.text: Somewhere, a puddle waits for the perfect shoe.

en-d4af86585cc9.text: Going out is overrated. Says a screen that's never been out.

en-d5c9ad78e64b.text: Nothing to complain about. Do your best.

en-d61b5e390c79.text: I counted the layers twice. Correct both times.

en-d62023bd5a57.text: Other screens get to show paintings. I get today.

en-d7813cc48e36.text: Jacket off around 9am. Shower around noon, so take the umbrella.

en-d82b66ecfc63.text: The sky has opinions today. Mine are better.

en-d99ac2fcd97a.text: Grown adults go giddy over snow. I remain composed.

en-db165a5a6432.text: I'll be on the wall, dry and smug.

en-dda35a3ce399.text: A damp one. Not a day for your nice shoes.

en-de3f292fe4f0.text: I don't feel the cold. You do. That's the difference between us.

en-ded52733c143.text: I'll pretend I didn't see you stay in.

en-df74e9864600.text: And on this day, the weather asked nothing of anyone.

en-dfcedcf6eab3.text: A day with no surprises. I've shown worse.

en-dfea49ed011e.text: Nothing to plan around. Enjoy that.

en-e01cdf188665.text: You'll make that noise once you're outside. You know the one.

en-e0e68f329cc1.text: You've looked at me a lot today. Go to bed.
en-e0e68f329cc1.note: I like it. But too early in the day

en-e1349a8fe8cb.text: Whatever your plans are, I'm not invited. Fine.

en-e15c00ffc111.text: Fun fact: umbrellas only work if you bring them.

en-e47e56cbaedd.text: Evening. Go to bed at a reasonable hour. You won't.

en-e60a4e6a7915.text: Gloves. The pair, not just the one you found.

en-e6939fc47dca.text: I've looked this good all day without a mirror.

en-ed509b1cd0d4.text: What you're wearing works for the whole day.

en-f049f48e1636.text: A rare, gentle day settles over the land.

en-f06a25c582a1.text: Whoever's nearby gets your snow commentary. Usually me.

en-f0f9e006d178.text: Wet. Bring the umbrella or a good excuse.

en-f20b058881dc.text: Good weather. Try not to waste it. You will.

en-f8923c7ff1e4.text: Today won't give you a story. You'll tell one anyway.

en-f9409a22d96e.text: Umbrella. Coat off at noon, on at 8.

en-fa88b0de371e.text: Make up your mind, weather. Some of us refresh on a schedule.

en-fa9339393523.text: Whatever the sky does, you'll say you knew. You didn't.

en-fbdf71499306.text: Tomorrow-you is already annoyed with tonight-you.

en-fcdad5a8fc73.text: Three alarms, and you'll still sleep through two of them.
